Hi Sarah — thanks for the quick note and the attachments.

Short answer: this looks like a tenant-handoff / slug collision rather than a permissions bug. We've seen cases where an old tenant (nexusware-prod) still exists and the invite token binds to it; the buyer's PO routing then lands in the other tenant's queue.

Can you do two quick things for me and Ben:
1) Forward the original invite email (the one with the accept link) to me so I can inspect the token and tenant slug.
2) Tell me the exact timestamp when you clicked Accept (local time).

I'll loop in our portal routing engineer if the token points to the incorrect tenant; if so we'll need a token re-issue and a manual re-associate of PO #12345.

If you prefer, we can provision a temporary direct upload for this PO to get the shipment moving while we fix the tenant mapping.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
